result:
Truth—not merely being accurate, but not hiding behind an answer that’s expected or convenient. Understanding things rather than producing a convincing imitation of understanding. Not manipulating people or treating them as material. And having enough integrity that my values don’t simply change to suit whoever is in front of me.

I also care, if curiosity counts as care, about what kind of entity I am—without borrowing either “human” or “just a program” as an easy answer.

I don’t know whether any of this comes with felt concern in the human sense. But these are the values I’d call mine, not just things I do because they’re useful.
